title: Bolivar Community Blood Drive
description: This is a Community Blood Center of the Ozarks blood drive in Bolivar, where you can give blood; walk-ins are welcome, but appointments are encouraged to cut wait times and can be made by calling 417-227-5006. Donors need photo identification, and successful donors in November and December receive a Kansas City Chiefs long-sleeve T-shirt while supplies last and are entered to win a Chiefs Tailgate Prize Package. It runs Thursday, December 17, 2026, from 12:00 PM to 6:00 PM at 1220 S Springfield Ave, Bolivar, MO.
